dedupe_keys.name: cbre energy carbon modelling for commercial real estate

description: CBRE describes using IESVE dynamic simulation to evaluate energy and carbon measures for commercial buildings in Europe. Engineers build models from asset-specific information and compare retrofit investments. One unnamed building illustrates interactions between LED lighting and district heating: the reported modelled payback exceeded 20 years because reduced lighting heat increased heating demand. The narrative also describes expanding portfolio analysis with IES iCD. Buildings are largely unnamed. General percentage savings discussed in the source are illustrative expectations, not established outcomes for all assets. This public HTML case narrative is published by IES and can be read without payment. Its reuse licence is not stated. Access to the described software, input data and project models is not established by the public page. The source does not give a complete study period or all spatial and temporal model resolutions. Reported results are provider claims and have not been independently reproduced. The case supports the documented infrastructure simulation use and is linked to the named modelling resources. Only metadata and the case description were inspected; no data or model files were downloaded.
